apps.name: TizenTube
apps.summary: YouTube without ads or sponsor segments.
apps.description: Loads the YouTube TV site and changes it with a script: ads removed, SponsorBlock skipping, extra settings. It is a TizenBrew site modification, so it runs inside TizenBrew.

compatibility.note: Working on a QN90B (Tizen 6.5) with TizenBrew 2.0.5 before this catalogue existed.

apps.name: Twizen
apps.summary: A Twitch player built for the TV remote.
apps.description: Watch Twitch live streams and videos. A TizenBrew app module with its own small background service.

compatibility.note: Working on a QN90B (Tizen 6.5) with TizenBrew 2.0.5. The npm entry names no source repository.

apps.name: Jellyfin
apps.summary: Jellyfin client: your own films, TV and music.
apps.description: The Jellyfin web client packaged as a TizenBrew app module. This build is no longer updated (last release November 2024); the Pindagus build below is maintained.
prerequisites: A Jellyfin server on your network

source.licence: Not declared in package.json (built from jellyfin-tizen and jellyfin-web)

compatibility.note: Working on a QN90B (Tizen 6.5) with TizenBrew 2.0.5.

apps.name: Jellyfin (maintained build)
apps.description: Jellyfin web 12.2 packaged for TizenBrew, updated regularly. Use this or the older build, not both.
prerequisites: A Jellyfin server on your network

compatibility.note: Not yet opened on this TV.

apps.name: Moonfin (TizenBrew)
apps.summary: Moonfin, a modern Jellyfin and Emby client, as a module.
apps.description: Community repackaging of the official Moonfin Smart TV app as a TizenBrew module. Playback uses the browser player; the Samsung native player is not available in this build.
prerequisites: A Jellyfin or Emby server on your network

compatibility.note: Not yet opened on this TV.

apps.name: Moonfin (standalone)
apps.summary: Official Moonfin app for Samsung TVs.
apps.description: The official Moonfin Smart TV build, a Jellyfin and Emby client with Samsung's native player. It is a separate TV app, not a TizenBrew module.
prerequisites: A Jellyfin or Emby server on your network
A PC to sign and install it once

compatibility.note: Upstream: Samsung Smart TVs 2017 and later. The release WGT is unsigned.

apps.install: Sign Moonfin_Tizen_Regular_v2.10.0.wgt with your own Samsung certificate on a PC, then install it with Apps2Samsung or TizenBrew Installer.

apps.name: Moonlight
apps.summary: Stream games from your gaming PC.
apps.description: Moonlight game-streaming client for Samsung TVs. Plays games running on a PC with Sunshine (or NVIDIA GameStream). Pair a controller to the TV for play.
prerequisites: A gaming PC running Sunshine on your network

compatibility.note: Upstream: Tizen 5.5 or newer (2020 models onwards). Do not use Moonlight-ForceGM.wgt, which is for Tizen 9.

apps.install: Re-sign Moonlight.wgt with your own Samsung certificate on a PC, then install it with Apps2Samsung or TizenBrew Installer.

apps.name: Tessel
apps.summary: Play files from network shares and USB drives.
apps.description: A media player (formerly VLC TV) that browses SMB, DLNA and WebDAV shares and USB storage.
prerequisites: A network share or USB drive with media
A PC to sign and install it once

compatibility.note: Upstream: Tizen TVs from 2017 onward. Upstream asks you to re-sign tessel.wgt with your own certificate.

apps.install: Re-sign tessel.wgt with your own Samsung certificate on a PC, then install it with Apps2Samsung or TizenBrew Installer.

apps.name: FCast Receiver
apps.summary: Receive videos cast from Grayjay and other FCast apps.
apps.description: The official FCast receiver for Samsung TVs. Upstream has marked the Tizen receiver as deprecated.
prerequisites: An FCast sender app such as Grayjay
A PC to sign and install it once

compatibility.note: Upstream: Tizen 5.0 (2019) and up. Deprecated by upstream.

apps.install: Re-sign FCastReceiver.wgt with your own Samsung certificate on a PC, then install it with Apps2Samsung or TizenBrew Installer.

apps.name: TizenCast
apps.summary: Community FCast receiver as a TizenBrew module. Not offered yet.
apps.description: An unofficial port of the FCast receiver. Its background service opens network listeners on the TV and runs with TizenBrew's full permissions. It is new (first published September 2026) and has not been reviewed or tested here, so this catalogue does not add it.
prerequisites: An FCast sender app such as Grayjay

compatibility.note: Not reviewed or tested. You can still add it yourself in TizenBrew's module manager as gh/BlindeCode/TizenCast.

apps.name: Overscan
apps.summary: A desktop-style web browser for the TV.
apps.description: Web browser from the Apps2Samsung project, built as a native .NET TV app (TPK). Not related to the Philips Hue project of the same name.
prerequisites: A PC with Apps2Samsung to install it

compatibility.note: Upstream lists Tizen 6.0 to 7.0; reports of it working on some 6.0 models and refused on others. Untested on Tizen 6.5.

apps.install: Install Overscan-tizen6.tpk with Apps2Samsung on a PC, which signs it for your TV.

apps.name: Chiaki (PlayStation Remote Play)
apps.description: Chiaki and chiaki-ng stream PlayStation 4 and 5 games, but they only exist for desktop computers, Android and Steam Deck. There is no Tizen build and no TizenBrew module, so it cannot be installed on this TV.

compatibility.note: Searched GitHub and npm on 2026-10-25: no Tizen port exists.

apps.install: No installation route exists. Use Moonlight with a PC instead, or PlayStation Remote Play on another device.
